set -euo pipefail
node workflow-source/scripts/docker-release-artifacts.mjs publish \
  --manifest "${RUNNER_TEMP}/docker-release/manifest.json" \
  --manifest-sha256 "${PREPARED_MANIFEST_SHA256}" \
  --artifact-name "${PREPARED_ARTIFACT_NAME}" \
  --run-id "${PREPARED_RUN_ID}" --run-attempt "${PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
  --directory "${RUNNER_TEMP}/docker-release/payloads"
